ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment/rake marks to high-intensity white background across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly high-intensity white surface across both lobes, heavily segmented by high-density, low-intensity linear marks. Higher concentration of low-intensity pixels concentrated at the peduncle-fluke transition and the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending into a narrow vertical split.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration; contains multiple low-amplitude peaks and semi-circular voids. Notable jagged protrusion on the left lobe outer trailing edge and a significant indentation on the right lobe inner trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer leading edges terminating in sharp, upward-tapering tips; concave trajectory along the trailing edge moving toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular high-intensity clusters concentrated on the lateral-most tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the leftmost tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions covering the majority of the visible ventral fluke surface, creating a cross-hatched texture.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface; irregular trailing edge geometry suggests previous tissue loss or mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density overlapping linear scar pattern creating a 'cross-hatch' geometric appearance across both the left and right mid-lobe regions.
